items.title: Rudolph Beaulieu Interview, 1961-05-31
items.q: Warline I bought that in front.

ctx.x: I bought a bass drum. I brought it home. It had a big fireplace, something like this. Mm-hmm. And, uh... I hadn't used it. Just bought it. From CG Conn. Bring it home. No, Warline I bought that in front. Set it in front of the fireplace. They had some dust in there somewhere or not. Might have swept dust in there, you know. And... I come in, I lit the... They had lamps. We had lamps. It didn't have no electric.
